notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an adapter-supplied rich FOM transportation type used by an ordinary attribute update. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback model, and object, attribute, and transportation names. It verifies object and attribute handle/name round-trips, transportation handle/name round-trips, ordinary publication, subscription, registration, discovery, update delivery, reflection metadata, and received transportation identity without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador FOM object and attribute lookup, ordinary object publication, subscription, registration, update, and transportation services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ordinary object-management and transportation declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
